Definition: to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tithe, take the tenth part of, give a tithe, take a tithe; 1a) (Qal) to tithe; 1b) (Piel) to give a tithe; 1c) (Hiphil) to take a tithe
